text:
anita: Heads-up — saw a persistent 15-25ms tail on APAC H100 runs vs EU for the hybrid-quant build (q4_0 fallback to q8) when batch_window_ms <= 30. Not sure if it's kernel choice or regional packing. Anyone else hit this?

jordan: Yep saw similar. Repro steps: run the perf harness with --model=mosaic-13b-ggml --quant=q4_0 --batch_window_ms=25 --max_batch_tokens=512 --region=apac1 --gpu=h100
jordan: output snippet:```latency_p50: 18ms, p95: 120ms, p99: 210ms, throughput_tok/s: 13500```

kai: can you paste the kernel mapping? I think APAC fleet is on triton-2.4 kernels, EU is on triton-2.6 + custom fused-attn.
jordan: kernel mapping: apac1 -> triton_2.4(gemm=gemm_v1,attn=flash_attn_v1), eu1 -> triton_2.6(gemm=gemm_v2,attn=flash_attn_v2_fused)

anita: right — flash_attn_v2_fused has a ~10-15ms improvement on long-tail because it coalesces KV cache reads for q4_0. APAC fallback to v1 explains some gap.
samir: also saw a quality regression after q4_0 -> q8 fallback in some prompt evals (conversational eval set). Rouge/semantic drift around ~1.8% avg drop for certain instruction-following prompts. Not huge but correlated with the larger batching.
lorna: can we decouple quality vs latency: run a quick A/B: apac1 q4_0 + small window (20ms) vs apac1 q8 + larger window (50ms) with same token budget. If q8+50ms gives same quality at lower p99, maybe prefer kernel+quant route.
jordan: queued a sweep: job id  /jobs/84219 with groups: [apac1/q4_0/25ms, apac1/q8/50ms, eu1/q4_0/25ms, eu1/q4_0/50ms] — small samples first.
infra-bot: job 84219 started on 2198765450. Allocated 6 H100 nodes in apac1, 4 in eu1. ETA ~22m.
kai: also try max_batch_tokens=256 for the q4_0 runs. Smaller token cap reduces tail for multi-turns.
samir: noted — will attach eval set (conv-regen-v2) to the sweep. Need per-prompt diffs to root-cause the semantic drift.
anita: another hypothesis: APAC scheduler is more aggressive on cohort packing (tilt=0.9) which mixes long and short traces — that increases tail for long ones. Can we run same kernel with tilt=1.0 (strict fairness) to compare?
jordan: yeah I added a control: tilt=1.0 in the eu1/q4_0/25ms run.
lorna: if tilt changes help, we might add an adaptive rule: if p95 > threshold then auto-bump tilt to 1.0 for that cohort.
kai: one more thing — KV prefix cache eviction observed on APAC during the run. Log shows repeated cache-miss spikes at t= +12m. That will blow up latency even at small windows.
anita: good catch. If cache churn is root cause, we tune cache_shards or increase per-worker kv_capacity. Can we get cache hitrate trace from job 84219?
infra-bot: uploaded metrics to /jobs/84219/metrics (apac1/eu1) at 2198765475.
jordan: quick interim: apac1 q4_0/25ms/mbt=512: cache_hit 0.78, p99 205ms. apac1 q8/50ms/mbt=256: cache_hit 0.92, p99 98ms, quality delta vs baseline: +0.4%
samir: interesting — q8 + higher window improved both p99 and quality. Suggests fallback quant+window is better than aggressive q4_0 here.
lorna: operational decision? Proposal: for APAC cohort A (long-tail traffic) set default quant=q8 and batch_window_ms=50, while EU keeps q4_0 + fused kernel. Rollout as canary to 5% first.
anita: +1 to canary. Also file a ticket to upgrade APAC kernels to triton_2.6 fused-attn; long term the kernel parity seems necessary.
kai: I'll open infra ticket and schedule kernel rollout.
jordan: I'll publish a short note to #eng-runtime with the experiment summary and the perf table.
anita: thanks — follow-up in 24h after full sweep completes. :rocket:
